_about: Feedback wall (/feedback/). Static, curated, updated weekly: the weekly workflow appends rows that Seffy set to status='approved' in public.feedback (fields id, created_at, page, reaction, message, name; NEVER email, ip_hash or user_agent). name: shown only when non-empty; null = no 'from' line at all. label: optional short title for the «על …» link; otherwise the post title is used. Links resolve at build time against published posts and /about/; a page that no longer exists simply gets no link. source: 'supabase' = real approved row; 'sketch' = curated seed quote from the vintage-postcards sketch (confirm with Seffy before merge).
